name: Filter Chip
summary: A filter chip is a button that stays pressed. Use it to switch a filter on and off without submitting a form. It is not a checkbox, so `aria-pressed` carries the state, and the pressed state needs a second cue besides color.
demoNote: Press any chip here and the readouts record what changed and what the chip is called afterwards. Every example on this page is live.

contract.useWhen: A filter you switch on and off: a button that remembers, not a checkbox.
keyboard: one stop per chip in a role=group row; one stop for the whole row in a role=toolbar
move between chips, wrapping. role=toolbar only
failureModes: a checkbox instead — aria-pressed is what says a button remembers
aria-pressed added only once pressed, so the control appears mid-page to a screen reader
a fill and nothing else, so the pressed state is carried by color alone (SC 1.4.1)
a tick typed in CSS content, which is folded into the accessible name
the label text swapped on toggle, so the name and aria-pressed announce a contradiction
